title: Release manifest (REQ-ART-002)
description: One <app>-v<version>.json file per release tarball in the artifacts folder, sibling to its .tar. See data-model.md.

version.description: Matches the VERSION file content and git tag suffix at cut time.

date.description: UTC date the release was cut (CONSTITUTION §II).

git_commit.description: Full SHA of the deployed commit the image was built from (git rev-parse HEAD at cut time).

image_id.description: Docker image ID/digest of the built <app>:<version> image, for verifying a loaded image matches this manifest.
